notes: GWS Streamer 2.10.0: Previous channel now lives in the playback menu directly above Channel list instead of sitting on screen. Free TV has a country menu (Canada, USA, UK) with a short curated picks list. Movies open on large-poster rows (Continue watching, Recently added, Favourites, genres) plus Browse all; posters show 4K/HD/year/progress only when the playlist supplies it. Backing out of a movie or player returns to the same poster and scroll position. Series pages show larger art, episode thumbnails and watched ticks, and the big button says Resume Sx Ex. Update install now continues automatically after you allow unknown sources.
